calculation.description: For each tradable asset, subtract the equal-weight cross-asset daily return, accumulate 20 trading days of residual return, and reverse it after volatility normalization. Uses only lagged information at signal time.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and above admission gates at the 20-day horizon across the full synthetic history; shorter horizons were weak, so use as medium-horizon factor. Small cross-section implies conservative interpretation; robustness comes from 2,181 daily IC observations.
